senses.gloss: दशन- + अंशु दशन- + अंशु, m. the brightness of the teeth.
दशाक्ष दशाक्ष, i. e. दशन्-, m. the name of a spell or charm.
दशाधिपति दशाधिपति, i. e. दशन्-, m. a commander of ten men, MBh. 12, 3712.

दशाब्द- + आख्य दशाब्द- + आख्य, i. e. दशन्-अब्द-, adj. declared to be of ten years, Man. 2, 134 (i. e. a citizen may be considered as equal to another citizen who is ten years older or younger than himself).
दशानन दशानन, i. e. दशन्-, adj. epithet of Rāvaṇa, Rām. 3, 39, 8.
दशास्य दशास्य, i. e. दशन्-, adj. epithet of Rāvaṇa.
दशकन्धर दशकन्धर, i. e. दशन्-, adj. having ten necks, epithet of Rāvaṇa, MBh. 3, 16516.
दशग्रामी दशग्रामी, i. e. दशन्-, f. a district of ten villages, MBh. 12, 3263.
दशग्रीव दशग्रीव, i. e. दशन्-, adj. 1. an epithet of Rāvaṇa, Rām. 1, 16, 18. 2. the name of a demon, MBh. 2, 367.
दास- + जन दास- + जन, m. the household servants, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 3.
दास- + जीवन दास- + जीवन, adj. living by slavish work, Man. 10, 32.

दश दश,
 1. instead of दशन्, Ten, MBh. 3, 15649.
 2. = दशम when latter part of a comp. numeral; cf. अष्टादश, द्वादश, त्रिदश.
 नव-दश, i. e. नवन्-, f. शी, Nineteenth.
 पञ्चदश, i. e. पञ्चन्-, f. शी,
 1. Fifteenth.
 2. f. शी, The fifteenth day of a half month.

दशा दशा, i. e. दंश् + अ, f.
 1. The skirt, or the ends of a garment, Man. 3, 44; Mṛcch. 26, 17.
 2. The wick of a lamp, Bhartṛ. 3, 1.
 3. Condition, state of life, Rām. 3, 75, 59.
 4. State, Kathās. 7, 113.
 5. Period, age, Hit. 10, 19; Hariv. 4394.

दाश दाश, written also दास दास,
 I. m.
 1. A fisherman, MBh. 1, 4012.
 2. A boatman, MBh. 1, 5875; Man. 8, 408 (with स्).
 3. The son of a Niṣāda by an Āgoyava-woman, Man. 10, 34 (with स्).
 II. f. शी, A fisher-maid.

दास दास, i. e. probably दम् + स,
 I. m. A slave, a servant, Man. 4, 253; 8, 416.
 II. f. सी, A female slave, a servant-maid, Man. 9, 48.
 --Cf. दाश.
 --Comp.

दशक दशक, i. e. दशन् + क, adj. Containing ten, Man. 6, 92.
 --Comp.
दशत् दशत्, f. (cf. दशन्), An aggregate of ten, a decade, Man. 8, 231.
दशति दशति (cf. दशन्), f. A hundred, MBh. 1, 1081.
दशधा दशधा, i. e. दशन् + धा, adv. In ten parts, Man. 9, 152.

दशन् दशन्, cardinal number,
 1. Ten, MBh. 3, 10677.
 2. Ten bad qualities, Hariv. 744.
 --Cf. δέκα; Goth. taihun and -tigu in tvaim-tigum; A.S. tên, -tig; Lat. decem; cf. दश.

दशन दशन, i. e. दंश् + अन, n. A tooth, Pañc. 52, 8; when latter part of a comp. adj., the fem. ends in ना, Man. 3, 10.
 --Comp.

दशम दशम, i. e. दशन् + म,
 I. ordinal number, f. मी, Tenth, Chr. 47, 38.
 II. f. मी,
 1. The tenth day of the half month, Man. 3, 276.
 2. The tenth decade of human life, Man. 2, 137.
 III. n. A tenth part, Man. 8, 33.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. decimus.
दशमास्य दशमास्य, i. e. दशन्-मास + य, adj. Of ten months, Bhāg. P. 1, 12, 11.
दशमीस्थ दशमी-स्थ (cf. दशम), [] adj. Above ninety years old, Man. 2, 138.
दशलक्षणक दशलक्षणक, i. e. दशन्-लक्षण + क, adj. Ten-fold, Man. 6, 91.

दशार्ण दशार्ण, m.
 1. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 1, 4449.
 2. Their king, Chr. 60, 33.
दशार्णक दशार्णक, read दाश्˚, Chr. 52, 10.
दाशार्णक दाशार्णक, i. e. दशार्न + अ + क, adj. णिका, Referring to the Daśārṇas, e. g., with नृप, The king of the Daśārṇas, Chr. 52, 11; with धात्री, A female servant of this people, Chr. 52, 16.

दशार्ह दशार्ह,
 1. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 3, 769.
 2. m. A proper name, Hariv. 1991.
 3. A name of Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 13, 7003.

दाशार्ह दाशार्ह, i. e. दशार्ह + अ,
 1. adj., f. ही, Belonging to Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 2, 84.
 2. m. A name of Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 2, 1223.
 3. m. pl. Daśārhas, the people, MBh. 1, 7513.
दशिन् दशिन्, i. e. दशन् + इन्, m. A lord of ten towns, Man. 7, 119.

दशेरक दशेरक, i. e. दंश् + एर + क, m.
 1. A young camel, MBh. 8, 1852.
 2. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 7, 397.

दासेरक दासेरक (स् probably erroaeously for श्, cf. दशेरक), i. e. दशेरक + अ, m.
 1. A camel, Pañc. 87, 8.
 2. pl. The name of a people, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 14, 26.
दशेश दशेश, i. e. दशन्-ईश, m. A lord of ten towns, Man. 7, 116.
दस् दस्, i. 4, Par. To become exhausted (ved.).

दाश् दाश्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To worship, Chr. 292, 6 = Rigv. i. 86, 6.
 2. To make oblations.
 3. To bestow.
 4. † ii. 5, Par. To hurt.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. act. ददाशिवंस्, Chr. 297, 20 = Rigv. i. 112, 20, and दाश्वंस्, 292, 12 = Rigv. i. 85, 12.
 1. Pious.
 2. Bestowing, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 23.

दस्यु दस्यु, m.
 1. A ruffian, a thief, Man. 7, 143.
 2. The name of one of the mixed classes, Man. 5, 131.
दस्युसात् दस्यु + सात्, adv. In the hand of ruffians, MBh. 12, 2554.

दस्र दस्र, adj.
 1. Helping(?), Chr. 295, 16 = Rigv. i. 92, 16.
 2. The name of one of the Aśvins, MBh. 1, 723.

दाशरथ दाशरथ, i. e.
 I. दशरथ, a proper name, + अ.
 1. patronym. A descendant of Daśaratha, Rām. 5, 80, 23.
 2. adj. Belonging to Daśaratha, Hariv. 4167.
 II. दशन्-रथ + अ, adj. Ten carriages broad, MBh. 12, 242.
दश(न्)- + रथ दश(न्)- + रथ, and दशपूर्व-, i. e. दश(न्)-पूर्व-, m. Daśaratha, the name of Rāma's father, and of others, Rām. 1, 72, 31 Gorr.; Ragh. 8, 29.
दाशरथि दाशरथि, i. e. दशरथ, see the last, + इ, patronym. A descendant of Daśaratha, Rām. 1, 3, 11; 6, 19, 67.
दाशार्हक दाशार्ह + क, m. pl. = Daśārhas, the people, Bhāg. P. 3, 1, 29.
दाशेय दाशेय, written also दासेय दासेय, i. e. दाशी + एय, m. and f. यी, The son, the daughter, of a fisherwoman, MBh. 1, 4015; Chr. 5, 1 (with स्).
दाश्वंस् दाश्वंस्, see दाश्.
दासी- + दास दासी- + दास, n. sing. and m. pl. male and female slaves, MBh. 13, 2950; 2, 2510.
दासत्व दास + त्व, n. Condition of a slave, Rām. 4, 3, 12.
दासप्रवर्ग दास-प्र-वर्ग, adj. Comprising a crowd of slaves, Chr. 294, 8 = Rigv. i. 92, 8.
दासीत्व दासी + त्व (see दास), n. The condition of a female slave, MBh. 1, 1088.

दास्य दास्य, i. e. दास + य, n.
 1. Servitude, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 11.
 2. Service, Man. 8, 410.
दास्वन्त् दास्वन्त् (vb. 1. दा, cf. भा and भास्), adj., f. वती, Liberal, Chr. 287, 1 = Rigv. i. 48, 1.
दास- + पण दास- + पण, playing for slavery [] (the loser becoming the slave of the winner), MBh. 5, 5518.
दश(न्)- + पल दश(न्)- + पल, n. ten palas.
दास्यास्- + पुत्र दास्यास्- + पुत्र (gen. sing. of दासी, see दास), m. the son of a female slave, a contemptible person.
दश(न्)-पुर दश(न्)-पुर, n. the name of a country.
दश-बन्ध दश-बन्ध, i. e. दशन्-, m. a fine amounting to the tenth part, Man. 8, 107.
दास- + भाव दास- + भाव, m. slavery, Draup. 9, 16.

दश(न्)- + मुख दश(न्)- + मुख,
 I. n. pl. ten faces, Bhāg. P. 9, 10, 23.
 II. adj. having ten faces, epithet of Rāvaṇa, Megh. 59.
दशवक्त्र दशवक्त्र, i. e. दशन्-, m. a certain spell, Rām. 1, 31, 6 Gorr.
दास- + वर्ग दास- + वर्ग, m. all the servants, Man. 3, 246.
दशवार्षिक दशवार्षिक, i. e. दशन्-, adj., f. की, 1. after the lapse of ten years, Yājñ. 2, 24. 2. having lasted ten years, Pañc. iii. d. 94.
दश-विध दश-विध, i. e. दशन्-, adj. tenfold, of ten kinds, Bhāg. P. 3, 6, 9.
दशा- + विपाक दशा- + विपाक, m. state, Mālat. 149, 4.
दशा- + विशेष दशा- + विशेष, m. a special condition, Hit. 78, 8, M.M.
दशशत दशशत, i. e. दशन्-, n., and f. ती, a thousand, MBh. 3, 2658 (त); Rājat. 5, 71 (ती).
दश-रश्मि- + शत दश-रश्मि- + शत, i. e. दशन्-, adj. (having a thousand rays), epithet of the sun, Ragh. 8, 29.
दशशीर्ष दशशीर्ष, i. e. दशन्-, m. 1. a name of Rāvaṇa, Rām. 4, 10, 22. 2. a spell, ib. 1, 30, 5.
दशार्ध- + संख्य दशार्ध- + संख्य, i. e. दशन्-अर्ध-, adj. five, Johns. Sel. 52, 113.

दशसाहस्र दशसाहस्र, i. e. दशन्-,
 I. adj. consisting of ten thousand, MBh. 4, 289.
 II. n. ten thousand, Hariv. 13900.
दासी- + सुत दासी- + सुत, m. a base man, Rājat. 5, 179.
